name: trafficking from ER to golgi regulator
pathways: positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction

function.text: TFG encodes protein TFG. It participates in positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction and COPII vesicle coat assembly.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to hereditary motor and sensory neuropathy, Okinawa type (autosomal dominant); hereditary spastic paraplegia 57 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include ALK-positive histiocytosis; NTRK-rearranged spindle cell sarcoma of the uterine cervix / corpus. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
